text: Level two, question three: two pipes fill a tank in twelve and fifteen minutes, and a third empties the full tank in twenty minutes; all three are opened on an empty tank; how long does it take to fill? Question four: pipe A fills a tank in twenty minutes and pipe B empties it in thirty minutes; both are opened on an empty tank; what fraction is full after twelve minutes? Question five: a full tank has an inlet that fills it in twenty hours and an outlet that empties it in twelve hours; both are opened; how long until the tank is empty?
